parameters.description:
Relay an SMS through your own D7 Networks account by posting a native D7 Networks payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`d7networks-sms-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `d7networks_sms` payload. The gateway composes the upstream D7 Networks URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Bearer access token
